notes.title: Will Glow the Wisp might be free soon!
notes.notes:
I am going to show School of Magic at this years gamescom and I am really excited. To celebrate I created a new Trailer and I am giving away Will Glow the Wisp for free if enough people Wishlist School of Magic. 
Here is how the event works
[list]
[*] 10 000 wishlist for School of Magic means that the price for Will Glow the Wisp drops from 2.99$ to 1.99$
[*] 15 000 wishlist drops the price to 0.99$
[*] 20 000 wishlists for School of Magic makes Will Glow the Wisp free
[*] The price will change either by the end of the Gamescom (Aug 28th 23:00 CET) or after 20 000 wishlists have been hit. Keep in mind that Valve still needs to process the request so expect a slight delay, after the event is over. 
[/list]

So if you want to get Will Glow the Wisp for free go and Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106680/School_of_Magic/?utm_source=SteamWillGlowTheWisp&utm_campaign=wishlistevent&utm_medium=web]School of Magic[/url] and just wait 😉

notes.title: Backend Server Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
As some of you already noticed there were some performance issues when loading levels if you had a ghost selected. In addition to that, the high scores took a very long time to load. The issues where the increase of players because of the free weekend, got my server to its limits. In order to fix that I reworked how I accessed data in my backend and now all these performance issues should be gone. 

Regards Nikolas Crisci

notes.title: Will Glow the Wisp - Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hi to you all,
I just set the version 1.2 of Will Glow the Wisp live it includes the following changes:

- Improved UI to contain more Information during Level Start
- Some minor Bugfixes
- Added a Privacy Policy Screen one time when you start the game
- Extended the Options to contain the Privacy Policy
- Added a way to play Offline, so none of your data is being transmitted.


I hope you enjoy these changes. 

As a side note, the work on the XBOX One version is continuing and I am expecting to release a version in August this year. As a part of that I am also planning to release a bigger update for Steam, including additional languages and some not announced changes, so keep an eye out.

Regards Niki

notes.title: About the new price
notes.notes:
I recently changed the price of the game from 7.99$ to 2.99$ and I wanted to explain to you why. I asked around my circles and I got mixed feedback, once people played the game most people would say that the old price was fine or even a bit cheap, but if they did not know it a lot felt it was too expensive. I think the main reason for that is the art style and to a lesser extend the genres. After a long internal struggle I decided to cut the price down to be more in line what people expect, because I want people to have fun with my game. I wanted to thank everyone who paid the full price. If this change in price makes you angry please contact me at parttimeindie@gmail.com and we will come up with a solution.

Regards Niki
